notes.title: Version 1.1 is Out Now! Also, Publisher News and Price Change!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you've been enjoying Girabox! Here are the patch notes for version 1.1:

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
- Added version counter.
- Fixed some locations where you would be stuck on seemingly random sides of the walls.
- Fixed bug where you would start the game in neither time or move mode.
- Fixed friend limit bug.
- Fixed jitter at the start of Pack G.
- Added pickle gang achievement.
- Changed some things regarding localisation.
- Fixed bug that would trigger the animation of all buttons if "Esc" was pressed on a level.
- Added key combination (shift + space + E + click) to delete times/moves of a level).
- Added keyboard shortcuts in the main menu. Pressing 0 will automatically move you to the options while pressing 1-7 will move you to the numbers' corresponding packs (A-G).
- Improved overall performance.
- Updated some metadata.

[h1]Price Change[/h1]
Currently, Girabox costs $1.49. However, on Monday the 28th of September this will change and the game will cost $1.99. This means that if you want to play the game, or have any friends who are interested in trying it out, do so before then! You're essentially getting the game at 25% off!

[h1]Publishing News[/h1]
I also have really awesome news of another kind regarding Girabox! You know, I think I'll just [url=https://twitter.com/CM_Games/status/1301855826215350272]let you see for yourself[/url].

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Also, if you're really interested in getting tips for improving your scores, the [url=https://discord.gg/UF3hwfk]official Conradical Games Discord[/url] is a great way to do that! You may have seen some insane numbers of the leaderboards, and everyone who's on the top is always talking and giving advice to new players. I highly recommend joining, it's a great time!
